title: Jalapeno Julienne Mexican Soy Milk Fried-Shoyu Empanadas
description: Umami rich Mexican soy milk empanadas with spicy jalapeno julienne, crunchy on the outside and savory on the inside.
instructions: Preheat a salt block to 375°F (190°C) for at least 30 minutes.
While the salt block is heating up, prepare the empanada dough according to the package instructions.
In a medium bowl, whisk together soy milk and shio-cure until fully incorporated.
Add chopped cilantro, scallions, and julienne-cut jalapeno to the bowl and mix well.
Roll out the empanada dough into thin circles, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of the soy milk mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the oil is hot, add the empanadas to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the empanadas to the preheated salt block and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
